name: Darts club
tagline: Your darts club or pub on its own server: player profiles, practice, live games and tournaments on a TV, players join with a QR code.
features: Player profiles with hand, level, entry mode and favourite double
Practice alone with drills made from your own statistics
Casual games with a join code or QR, live scoring on a phone and a TV view
Tournaments with brackets for your club nights
